{{Quote|Ransack the Republic's labs. Take their research, then destroy everything. We don't want them salvaging the project.|Agent Kayd|<ref name="TOR" />}}
'''Kayd''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Imperial Agent]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] living during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. She was stationed on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] and asked a fellow Imperial to put a stop to a [[Spice/Legends|spice]] smuggling operation that got many other Imperials addicted.<ref name="TOR" />
